no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the ORGOVYX (relugolix) NDA214621 approval. The FDA Multidiscipline Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) explicitly states the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee. There is therefore no AdComm concern-to-change linkage for this approval.
